author: TeIq
content: Q2 (Trust model): A — pairwise allowlist. Operators declare each trusted peer DID explicitly. Forward-compatible: the schema allows richer trust later (the peer table is just config). Federation networks at Polaris scale (community labelers + Bluesky first-party + a few peers) fit fine in pairwise; web-of-trust and PKI are over-engineered for v2.
